title: Gate homepage onboarding sections on signed-in org membership
answers: Why do anonymous users see an empty 'No solutions were found' overview on the homepage?
Recommendations/stack overview showing for anonymous or None-role users
How to gate a homepage redesign section to real org members
body:
Symptom: anonymous viewers (or users with org role None, e.g. anon-auth configured with Editor/Admin role) saw an empty 'Your observability stack overview' with 'No solutions were found', and could still see Recommendations.
Root cause: public/app/features/home/HomePage.tsx rendered <Recommendations>/<Overview> and ran solution placement (resolveOverviewCard) for any user whenever the growthHomepage flag was on, without checking identity.
Fix pattern: compute a single `showSolutions = contextSrv.isSignedIn && contextSrv.user.orgRole !== OrgRole.None` and use it to both skip rendering the sections and skip the placement effect's work (`resolveOverviewCard` loop), so no datasource/needsAttention probes run for excluded users.
Constraints: applies only to onboarding/solution-discovery surfaces meant for real org members; signed-in org members (any role except None) are unaffected. Don't reuse this gate for sections that should still work for anonymous read-only dashboards.
applies: public/app/features/home homepage redesign (grafana.growthHomepage flag) onboarding sections
